challenges.title: ERO minimum wage, night allowance and PSA standards

items.title: ERO minimum wage since July 2025
items.text: The Employment Regulation Order of the Security Industry Joint Labour Committee (S.I. No. 326/2025) raised the minimum wage on 22 July 2025 from €14.50 to €15.41 per hour.

items.title: €20 night allowance since 2026
items.text: Since 1 January 2026, an allowance of €20.00 per night shift applies — hard to calculate correctly by hand across many sites and changing shifts.

items.title: PSA licence & standards inspection
items.text: As part of the Licensing Standards, PSA auditors check whether ERO employment conditions are being met — non-compliance can lead to findings in the licensing process.

solutions.title: How Klacks takes the load off security services in Ireland
solutions.subtitle: From covered posts to documented night shifts — it all fits together.

items.title: Sites & posts, gap-free
items.text: Every post across every site — Klacks flags every open slot instantly and fills it automatically on request.

items.title: ERO rates stay in payroll
items.text: Klacks does not calculate the ERO minimum wage of €15.41 per hour — Klacks provides your payroll with the planned hours as a basis, and you maintain the rates there.

items.title: Night shifts reported
items.text: Klacks reports the night shifts per employee. Your payroll applies the allowance of €20.00 per night shift since 1 January 2026 — Klacks does not calculate any monetary amounts.

items.title: PSA standards kept in view
items.text: Klacks documents compliance with the ERO employment conditions that PSA auditors check as part of the Licensing Standards.

items.title: Installed on your premises: data stays in-house
items.text: Klacks runs on your own infrastructure — deployment and client data stay in your organisation, and with a locally hosted AI model, for the AI too.

items.title: Klacksy understands your request
items.text: "Cover the night shift at the North site" is enough — Klacksy starts the planning, Klacks checks availability at the same time.
